Maya (PM): Quick sync: need a concise roadmap fragment for Private Deploy launch covering VPC/on-prem packaging, upgrade lanes, and customer-managed networking obligations. Keep it sales-friendly.
Ethan (SRE): Suggest 3 prioritized items: 1) Install presets (minimal/standard/enterprise) 2) Upgrade policy matrix (auto rolling / scheduled / pinned) 3) Network ownership checklist (egress IP preservation).
Pri (Legal): Keep contractable commitments narrow. Blackout windows, pinned versions, and reserved IPs must be SOW items for Enterprise only.
Rox (Sales): Field asks: finance customers want monthly blackout slots + IP preservation. We need one-liners for quotes.
Maya (PM): Draft single-sentence lines: "Minimal: self-serve, best-effort egress, automated rolling upgrades." "Standard: field-assisted, reserved IPs on request, scheduled upgrades." "Enterprise: contractual guarantees (blackouts, reserved egress, pinned versions)." Good?
Nikhil (Solutions): Add prerequisites: preserved IPs require customer-provided IP allocation and a named network contact, pinned versions require acceptance of longer rollback windows.
Ethan (SRE): Ops impact bullets for doc: "pinned-version storage + KV migration cost", "monthly blackout = scheduled blocking (low ops cost)", "per-event blackout = on-call labor (high ops cost)". Put numbers later.
Pri (Legal): Contract phrase suggestion: "Customer blackout windows are enforceable only for Enterprise tier when explicitly listed in the SOW; other tiers are accommodated on a best-effort basis."
Rox (Sales): Pricing model proposal: include blackout slot as an add-on (monthly fee) and per-event premium for ad-hoc holds. We'll give bands after pilot.
Maya (PM): Action list: Ethan -> fill ops-cost bullets; Nikhil -> collect two pilot examples; Pri -> SOW snippet; Rox -> sample price bands. I'll stitch into launch checklist and publish.
deploy-bot: Created ticket PRIV-911 for "Private Deploy launch fragment" and assigned to Maya.
Maya (PM): End of thread. Short and actionable.
